# BeatOS — The MakerLicious (Astro1Deep)

> Open-source local-first sample library browser, Akai MPC project inspector, and 16-pad beatmaking kit workspace with ES/EN web interface. Developer: Astro1Deep. Repository: https://github.com/Astro1Deep/BeatOS-TheMakerLicious

Important: BeatOS runs on the user's computer and does not install sampler firmware. The hardware export targets differ in compatibility; WAV/JSON transport bundles are not native hardware backups. Indexing estimates BPM/key from names and energy from a small number of PCM RMS windows, not full-file beat/key or loudness recognition. Download a release ZIP rather than assuming GitHub's source ZIP is an installer.

## Hardware export workflows

- Akai MPC: Drum XPM and XPJ based on a specific MPC Sample AC50 template. Not a certified universal MPC project.
- Native Instruments Maschine: WAV audio plus JSON mapping, not native MXGRP.
- Roland SP-404MKII: WAV16/48 kHz import files, pad placement subject to firmware workflow.
- Roland SP-404A / SX: 12-pad WAV16/44.1 kHz files.
- Teenage Engineering PO-33 / PO-133: audio sampling reel, not an FSK modem-data backup.
- Teenage Engineering EP-133 K.O. II: WAV/ZIP transport and mapping, not a native project backup.
